title: OpenPlanr .run-manifest.jsonl line object (v1.0.0)
description: Single JSON Lines record appended to SPEC_DIR/.run-manifest.jsonl (spec-driven) or output/feats/feat-{slug}/.run-manifest.jsonl (default). Append-only lifecycle — never truncate the manifest file wholesale.

stage.description: Orchestration boundary label (e.g. ship.bootstrap, ship.inputs-done, ship.task:T-003, qa-gate).

agent.description: Subagent slug or null when no agent (orchestration-only milestone).

files_modified.description: Repo-relative POSIX paths of files edited in place.

error_summary.description: null when exit_status !== failure; otherwise one concise line.

cost_hint.description: Optional non-binding cue surfaced in status when present.
